delete.description: Permanently deletes a trading account owned by the authenticated user, along with its derived performance history (portfolio snapshots). For non-demo accounts, refuses to delete an account that still has positions, or one that is referenced by a generated tax report — close the account instead to preserve that history. Ownership and retention checks run under the same account lock as participating trade/import writes and new tax-report references. Deletion cascades inactive opening drafts, draft cash operations and import batches; it does not confirm or activate accounting.

post.description: Changes the live manual long BUY date, quantity, price and fees, recomputes parcel cost basis, remaining inventory and realized results, and appends an immutable cash revision with before/after source snapshots and fingerprint continuation. Sale quantities and allocations never change. The parcel must have exactly one BUY, cover all sales and precede their dates. Same-day sales require effective draft cash ordered after the acquisition. Imported parcels and broker-linked sales are excluded. Account, instrument, currency and source identity cannot change. The acquisition must stay after opening and within the original observation date. Quantity is an exact decimal string with at most 12 fractional digits, at most 9007199254740991, and must round-trip through the existing Float storage without changing decimal value. Gross consideration is quantity times price rounded half-up to 2 decimal places. Same-Sydney-date edits retain timestamps; changed dates use 01:00 UTC. The original opening and statement evidence remain unchanged; unrelated drafts and tax reports can become stale. No spendable cash or accounting activation is enabled.

Supply replacement null for a terminal reversal. The expected revision prevents lost updates; identical retries return the saved correction. Dated replay rejects downstream funding gaps. No live balances or holdings change.

post.description: Explicitly changes the live manual SELL date, price and fees, recomputes parcel totals, and appends exact cash reversal/replacement postings with immutable before/after trade snapshots and source fingerprint continuation. Quantity, parcel, instrument, currency and source identity cannot change. Imported sources and cash-only reversal are unsupported. Gross consideration is quantity times price rounded half-up to the transaction's two decimal places. A same-Sydney-date correction preserves the original timestamp; changing date records the new calendar date at 01:00 UTC. Dates must remain after opening, on/after acquisition and within the original observation date. Same-day sales must follow effective acquisition cash in explicit sequence order. The original opening snapshot and statement evidence never change; other drafts become stale. Expected revision/source and idempotency checks serialize edits. This changes live trade history and can make existing tax reports stale, but does not activate accounting or post spendable cash.

Concurrent changes return 409 and require reviewing a refreshed plan; the import is not silently reallocated. Parcel creation, allocated SELLs, recomputed results and event links commit or roll back together. No live cash postings or opening activation are performed.

delete.description: Deletes under owned-account and parcel locks. Inactive opening and cash draft snapshot references are retained; source changes prevent further draft appends. Dedicated coordinated correction or source-aware adjustment is required; reversing cash does not release its identity.

patch.description: Crypto symbols must match the venue quote currency. Changing a Kraken instrument validates its market; unchanged historical instruments remain editable. Acquisition edits commit the BUY and recomputed parcel results together. Bought units cannot be reduced below already-sold units. Account moves lock both accounts in stable order and recheck the demo/real boundary. Inactive draft cash is not spent or activated. An edit or move that would leave open holdings in a closed account returns 409; reopen the account first. Corrections and moves of fully closed history remain allowed. Imported acquisition values and source identities cannot be changed here. Financial edits, instrument/account changes and deletion of cash-linked trades require coordinated correction and return 409 here, including for reversed cash operations. The opening reconciliation workflow supports manual acquisition and sale corrections, not deletion or moves. Notes and metadata remain editable; resubmitting unchanged financial values is allowed.

post.description: For an open long position with a stop loss that is not already flagged, decides whether the stop has been reached and, if so, persists stopLossHitAt so the flag survives the price recovering. If currentPrice is supplied and at or below the stop, the stop is flagged immediately. Otherwise daily lows are scanned from the time the stop was last set (or the open date, if never changed) to today; the first day whose low reached the stop becomes stopLossHitAt (day-granular). Editing the stop loss price clears the flag. Already-flagged, closed, short, or stop-less positions are returned unchanged. Saving rechecks the stop and holding inputs under user/account/parcel locks; concurrent changes return 409 rather than persisting a stale hit.

post.description: Computes a capital gains summary for the given Australian financial year across an explicit set of Trading Accounts (a "declaration"), renders a PDF, and stores it as a new revision for that (financial year, account selection) combination. Previous revisions are retained and stay downloadable so an already-lodged report is never overwritten. Regenerating with unchanged content returns the existing current revision instead of creating a new one. Dates in newly generated PDFs use dd/MM/yyyy; regenerating a report with the older date format creates a new revision without modifying the original PDF. New revisions lock selected accounts in stable ID order and recheck ownership and non-demo eligibility before storing account references. A concurrent deletion or report revision change fails explicitly instead of orphaning a new report.

delete.description: Marks the account deleted and revokes every session immediately. The data is retained until the grace period expires, during which signing in returns 403 with `accountPendingDeletion` and the account can be restored via POST /api/auth/restore. After that a scheduled purge removes the user and all their positions, accounts, snapshots, tax reports and watchlists. An exclusive user lock waits for participating financial writes before marking deletion and revoking sessions together. In-flight writes waiting behind deletion are refused even if their initial authentication check already succeeded.
